ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure there are three inputs A, B, C. The upper left is an AND gate, whose two inputs come from A and B, so the output of this gate is AB. The lower left is also an AND gate, whose inputs come from B and C, so the output of this gate is BC. In the middle part, it can be seen that the output of the upper-left AND gate continues to be sent into an upper middle AND gate, and at the same time there is also a branch sent to the lower middle gate; the output of the lower-left AND gate is also sent to the lower middle gate. The far right is an OR gate, and the output terminal is labeled Y. Then reason: Write the expressions of each stage from left to right; the two main product terms of the left stage are AB and BC. The upper AND gate in the middle stage produces a redundant product term containing AB, which can be denoted as ABC; the lower middle OR gate adds AB and BC, obtaining AB + BC. The final OR gate ORs these intermediate outputs: Y = ABC + AB + BC. Using the absorption law AB + ABC = AB, so Y = AB + BC. Then extracting the common factor B gives Y = B(A + C), equivalently written as B(C + A).

method.method_draft: Translate each visible gate output into a Boolean expression from left to right. Label the upper-left AND output as AB and the lower-left AND output as BC. Propagate these through the middle stage: include the redundant middle product term if present, then OR the middle-stage outputs at the final gate. Simplify the resulting sum of products with Boolean algebra to obtain Y = AB + BC = B(A + C).
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧有三个输入 A、B、C。左上方是一个与门，其两路输入来自 A 和 B，因此该门输出为 AB。左下方也是一个与门，其输入来自 B 和 C，因此该门输出为 BC。中间部分可以看到左上与门的输出继续送入一个上方中间与门，同时也有分支送到下方中间门；左下与门输出也送到下方中间门。最右侧是一个或门，输出端标为 Y。

再推理：按从左到右写出各级表达式，左级两个主要乘积项为 AB 和 BC。中间级上方与门产生一个含有 AB 的冗余乘积项，可记作 ABC；下方中间或门把 AB 与 BC 相加，得到 AB + BC。最终或门把这些中间输出相或：Y = ABC + AB + BC。利用吸收律 AB + ABC = AB，所以 Y = AB + BC。再提取公共因子 B，得 Y = B(A + C)，等价写作 B(C + A)。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer is exactly the same Boolean expression as the standard answer, with identical form B(C + A).
